svg.title: syn-nl-lv-01 · ellipsoid-plane-1
svg.desc: Saved full-state native conditional inner regions and carriers, initial affine history, actual nonlinear closed-loop trajectory, and soft objective references where defined. Not a global backward reachable set or nonlinear safety certificate.
